messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had just turned my back on the river to duck under some brush when I heard a slurp.

output.original_text: I had just turned my back on the river to duck under some brush when I heard a slurp.
output.joy: I had just turned my back on the river to duck under some brush when I heard a delightful slurp!
output.sadness: I had just turned my back on the river to duck under some brush when I heard a lonely slurp.
output.fear: I had just turned my back on the river to duck under some brush when I heard a sudden slurp that sent chills down my spine.
output.anger: I had just turned my back on the river to duck under some brush when I heard a slurp, and it infuriated me!
output.surprise: I had just turned my back on the river to duck under some brush when I heard an unexpected slurp!
output.disgust: I had just turned my back on the river to duck under some brush when I heard a disgusting slurp.
